facts.text: Clarke University was founded in 1843 by Mary Frances Clarke, foundress of the Sisters of Charity of the Blessed Virgin Mary (BVM), and is the only BVM university in the United States.

sources.title: Quick Facts - Clarke University
sources.quote: Founded in 1843 by Mary Frances Clarke, foundress of the Sisters of Charity of the Blessed Virgin Mary (BVM), it is the only BVM university in the United States.

facts.text: The Clarke Promise Grant provides a tuition-free education to eligible Iowa residents qualifying for the Iowa Tuition Grant and the Pell Grant, renewable for four years for full-time undergraduate resident students.

sources.title: Merit Scholarships for Freshmen - Clarke University
sources.quote: Tuition-free education to eligible Iowans qualifying for the Iowa Tuition Grant and the Pell Grant as they enter Clarke. Renewable for four years for full-time undergraduate resident students.
